1.why: The screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with bold labels, roomy line spacing in the body paragraphs and generous padding around fields, though the small all-caps 'Step X of 3' and 'NORTHSTAR BANK' labels are tight.

2.why: Body text is short and non-italic, but the step indicator and bank name are rendered in letter-spaced all-caps, and the 'Use different details' link is underlined bold, so all-caps is not fully avoided.

3.why: The card is a single centred narrow column with full-width inputs and buttons that would reflow acceptably, but the screenshots are only shown at desktop width so mobile rendering is unverified, and the dark 'Logs' console panel is developer clutter.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Enter the six-digit code sent to your phone. The code expires in 10 minutes.' are one or two short plain-language sentences.

5.why: Only the phone field shows a format example ('+447700900000'); the email and identity verification code fields have empty inputs with no sample or format hint.

6.why: No screen contains more than a two-line paragraph before the actionable field, so no long text block blocks progress.

7.why: No copy button, copy-to-clipboard control, or downloadable secret is visible anywhere; codes must be typed into the input by hand and the OTP/recovery-code screens are not even present.

8.why: No QR code or scan alternative appears in any of the five screenshots; the authenticator enrolment screen with a QR option is absent entirely.

9.why: Fields are standard labelled inputs which may work with autofill, but there is no visible evidence of autocomplete attributes, one-time-code support, or password-manager affordances.

10.why: Each card shows a 'Step 2 of 3' marker, a large bold heading, and a single high-contrast full-width primary button that dominates the layout.

11.why: Steps 2–5 request only one input and one primary action; step 1 asks for two related fields (email and phone) under a single Continue button.

12.why: Step 1 hints that a check will be sent to the phone, but after submitting there is no plain success confirmation of what happened — only a generic failure banner and an empty developer 'Logs' box.

13.why: The user can re-enter the code and 'Use different details', but there is no visible resend/re-request code control, no reveal/hide toggle, and no recovery-code re-display option.

14.why: The banner reads 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' — it does not blame the user, but it also fails to state the actual problem or how to fix it.

15.why: A 10-minute code expiry is imposed and stated, and no extension, pause, or 'need more time' option is offered, though nothing limits reading time explicitly.
